one_line: Web scraping and automation platform with an actor marketplace, run via a REST API or SDK clients.
auth_notes: Personal API token from the Apify dashboard sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'; token scoped to the user account
self_serve_notes: Free tier with monthly usage credits, then usage-based paid plans; API token self-serve from dashboard, no approval needed

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Full platform API (api.apify.com/v2): actors, tasks, runs, datasets, key-value stores, request queues, schedules, webhooks, storages; complete OpenAPI schema published
api_surface.webhook_note: Actor run finished/failed webhooks documented; also has real-time events and webhook settings per actor

existing_mcp.note: Official Apify MCP server exists (knowledge); fetched text confirms REST API, OpenAPI schema and official client libraries for JS/Python/Go

evidence.note: fetched text confirms Bearer token auth, REST API v2, OpenAPI spec and API clients

agent_notes: Very well-documented API; free tier makes first call trivial.
